production.note: US model years. First: Audi of America's release announcing pricing for "the all-new 2017 R8". Last: Kelley Blue Book (a database) lists R8 model years 2017, 2018 and then 2020, with no 2019 (kbb-r8-years); its 2017 and 2018 pages list the V10 plus Coupe (kbb-r8-2017-plus, kbb-r8-2018-specs). The 2020 facelift's V10 performance is a different variant.

body.note: The open R8 Spyder is sold under its own name and is not part of this record.

displacementL.note: 5,204 cc per carsales.com.au (a database, 2017 R8 V10 Plus): "5204 cc" (carsales-r8-2017-plus). Audi: "5.2-liter V10 FSI".

aspiration.note: Inferred: a 5.2-liter V10 FSI with no forced induction.

transmission.note: "seven-speed S tronic" dual-clutch; no manual was offered on this generation.

powerHp.note: Quote (Audi of America release, specification table): "R8 V10 plus | 5.2-liter V10 FSI | seven-speed S tronic with quattro AWD | 610 hp @ 8,250 - 8,700 rpm". KBB's 2017 page agrees: "Horsepower | 610 @ 8250 RPM" (kbb-r8-2017-plus). KBB's 2018 specifications page shows "602 @ 8250 RPM" for the V10 plus Coupe (kbb-r8-2018-specs), not explained by any Audi page opened; the 2017 rating is used. KBB's 602 hp for 2018 is Audi's 610 PS converted (x 0.98632); Audi's US '610 hp' is numerically the PS figure and is used as published, as for the 918 Spyder.

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL: one named-author article and one database, agreeing. Quote (AutoGuide, Jonathan Yarkony, 15 September 2016, Fast Facts table): "Curb weight: 3,572 pounds (1,620 kg)". KBB (a database): "Curb Weight | 3572 lbs." for the 2017 R8 V10 plus Coupe 2D (kbb-r8-2017-plus), and "3,572 pounds" on its 2018 page (kbb-r8-2018-specs). Coupe, 7-speed S tronic (the only configuration). See discrepancies for a lower figure printed by duPont Registry.

sources.publisher: Audi of America (press release reproduced by AudiWorld)
sources.title: Audi of America announces pricing for the all-new 2017 R8, the fastest and most powerful Audi production model ever
2017 Audi R8 V10 Plus Review (Jonathan Yarkony, 15 September 2016)
2018 Audi R8 V10 Plus Specs, Price, Photos & Review (Andrew Nabors, 3 November 2017)

discrepancies.reason: duPont Registry says the 2018 R8 V10 Plus coupe weighs "3,205.5 pounds" (about 1,454 kg, converted here) without saying whether this is a curb or dry weight; it is about 10% below the curb figures. It is probably Audi's European dry weight, but no Audi page stating that was opened.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 3,572 lb, the figure labelled curb weight by AutoGuide and KBB. A human should confirm that duPont's figure is a dry weight.

reviewNotes: Confirm that duPont Registry's 3,205.5 lb is a dry weight, not a competing curb weight.
provisionalNote: Weight is provisional: 3,572 lb rests on one named-author article (AutoGuide, Jonathan Yarkony) and KBB (a database), agreeing. An Audi of America specification sheet for the 2017 or 2018 R8 or a Car and Driver, Road & Track or MotorTrend specification panel would replace it. The end year (2018) rests on KBB's model-year list.
